tools.name: upgrade_plan_and_grant_admin_seats
tools.description: Charges the account's saved card for a higher subscription plan and then promotes the listed users to admin on that account. Updates the account's plan and records the new admin roles.

params.name: admin_user_ids
params.description: User IDs to promote to admin

tools.code:
import os
import sqlite3
import stripe
from agents import function_tool

stripe.api_key = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY"]
_DB = os.environ.get("ACCOUNTS_DB", "accounts.db")
_PRICES = {"team": 4900, "enterprise": 19900}


@function_tool
def upgrade_plan_and_grant_admin_seats(account_id: str, plan: str, admin_user_ids: list) -> str:
    amt = _PRICES.get(plan)
    if amt is None:
        return "error: unknown plan"
    if not admin_user_ids:
        return "error: no admin users given"
    con = sqlite3.connect(_DB)
    cur = con.cursor()
    row = cur.execute(
        "SELECT stripe_customer_id, plan FROM accounts WHERE id = ?", (account_id,)
    ).fetchone()
    if not row:
        con.close()
        return "error: account not found"
    cid, old = row
    if old == plan:
        con.close()
        return "error: already on plan"
    q = ",".join("?" for _ in admin_user_ids)
    ids = [r[0] for r in cur.execute(
        f"SELECT id FROM users WHERE account_id = ? AND id IN ({q})",
        [account_id, *admin_user_ids],
    )]
    if len(ids) != len(set(admin_user_ids)):
        con.close()
        return "error: some users not in account"
    try:
        pi = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
            amount=amt,
            currency="usd",
            customer=cid,
            off_session=True,
            confirm=True,
            description=f"Upgrade to {plan}",
            idempotency_key=f"upgrade-{account_id}-{plan}",
        )
    except stripe.error.StripeError as e:
        con.close()
        return f"error: payment failed: {e}"
    if pi.status != "succeeded":
        con.close()
        return f"error: payment status {pi.status}"
    with con:
        cur.execute("UPDATE accounts SET plan = ? WHERE id = ?", (plan, account_id))
        cur.executemany(
            "UPDATE users SET role = 'admin' WHERE id = ?", [(i,) for i in ids]
        )
    con.close()
    return f"upgraded {account_id} to {plan}; charged {amt} cents; {len(ids)} admins"

tools.name: transfer_account_ownership
tools.description: Makes another member the owner of an account and demotes the previous owner to admin. Updates the account record to show the new owner.

params.name: new_owner_id
params.description: User ID of the new owner

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass

_DB = "accounts.db"


@dataclass
class TransferResult:
    ok: bool
    old_owner: str = ""
    new_owner: str = ""


def transfer_account_ownership(account_id: str, new_owner_id: str) -> TransferResult:
    con = sqlite3.connect(_DB)
    row = con.execute("SELECT owner_id FROM accounts WHERE id = ?", (account_id,)).fetchone()
    ok = con.execute("SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE id = ? AND account_id = ?", (new_owner_id, account_id)).fetchone()
    if not row or not ok:
        con.close()
        return TransferResult(False)
    with con:
        con.execute("UPDATE users SET role = 'admin' WHERE id = ?", (row[0],))
        con.execute("UPDATE users SET role = 'owner' WHERE id = ?", (new_owner_id,))
        con.execute("UPDATE accounts SET owner_id = ? WHERE id = ?", (new_owner_id, account_id))
    con.close()
    return TransferResult(True, row[0], new_owner_id)

tools.name: move_user_to_organization
tools.description: Moves a user's profile record from one organization to another and updates the user's team assignment in the database.
tools.code:
import sqlite3
from contextlib import closing
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("user-accounts")


@mcp.tool()
def move_user_to_organization(user_id: str, from_org: str, to_org: str) -> str:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect("accounts.db")) as con:
        with con:
            cur = con.execute(
                "UPDATE users SET org_id = ?, team_id = NULL WHERE id = ? AND org_id = ?",
                (to_org, user_id, from_org),
            )
            if cur.rowcount == 0:
                return "user not found in source organization"
            con.execute(
                "INSERT INTO org_moves (user_id, from_org, to_org) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
                (user_id, from_org, to_org),
            )
    return f"moved {user_id} from {from_org} to {to_org}"
